title: Director of Engineering
summary: A director of engineering leads several engineering teams through their managers, usually reporting to a VP Engineering or CTO. They own the technical roadmap for a product area, set architecture direction, hire and grow managers, and make sure the teams deliver reliably. In India they often lead the India centre of a global product company.
dailyDuties: Review delivery, quality and reliability across teams
Review designs and major technical decisions
Agree quarterly plans with product leaders
Plan headcount and budget for the area

skills.expectation: Set architecture direction across several teams
Review designs for scale and reliability
Hire managers and senior engineers and set the hiring bar
Own the technical roadmap for a product area
Run delivery across teams and dependencies
Agree plans with product and business leaders
Set reliability targets and on-call standards
Control cloud spend for the area
Shape team structure as the area grows
Brief the CTO and leadership on delivery
